upgrades.desc: Samples taken for the 3D printer are +10.0% bigger!
+4 Obol storage slots per upgrade! Circle, Square, Hexagon, then Sparkle, in that order.
+152% Refinery Speed for all cycle types. In other words, cycles take less time.
+20.0% Class EXP and Skill EXP. Not really sure what those blobulytes do with these souls...
+20 Max level for talent books from the library. RNG be with you!
+100% Liquid rate and Capacity for all liquids in Alchemy.
+50% Points Earned during Worship Tower Defense from killing monsters.
+10.0% Movement Speed. Doesn't work if you're above 170% move speed already.
+30% Multikill Rate for all worlds. All of them!
+35% Cooking Mastery EXP gain, a feature unlocked via Rift 61 deep in World 4.
